notes: Plain-text 10-Q of Empire Global Corp. (later Elys BMG Group) for the quarter ended June 30, 2007, filed late in 2009. Uncertain: 'ITEM 1. FINANCIAL STATEMENTS' appears twice before the statements: at line 30, between the cover and the contents list, with the sentence 'The un-audited quarterly financial statements ... immediately follow.', and again at line 47, after the contents list (lines 33 to 46, not labeled) and directly above the statements. Part I Item 1 is labeled at the second, which heads the statements; the alternative is line 30, which would put the contents list inside Item 1. There is no PART I line in the body. Part I Item 3 and Part II Item 1A say a smaller reporting company is not required to provide the information and are marked incorporated. Part II Items 2 and 3 say only 'None.', which is an answer, so they are not marked (the labelers differed here); Part II Items 4 ('No matter was submitted ...') and 5 are answers too. Part II Item 6 lists exhibits 31 and 32. The filing ends at the second SIGNATURES line; the first is the last line of the contents list.
